name: lazygit-vscode
description: Native integration of LazyGit in a maximized VSCode terminal panel

lazygit-vscode.lazygitPath.description: The path to the lazygit executable

lazygit-vscode.configPath.description: Path to a custom LazyGit config file (otherwise use default)

sidebar.description: Sidebar restore behavior. LazyGit always hides the primary sidebar while shown.
enumDescriptions: Do not restore the primary sidebar when LazyGit closes
Do not restore the primary sidebar when LazyGit closes
Restore the primary sidebar when LazyGit closes

panel.description: Deprecated. LazyGit now runs in the terminal panel, so this setting is ignored.
panel.markdownDeprecationMessage: **Deprecated**: LazyGit now runs in the terminal panel, so this setting is ignored.
enumDescriptions: Hide panel when showing lazygit and restore when closing

secondarySidebar.description: Secondary sidebar restore behavior. LazyGit always hides the secondary sidebar while shown.
enumDescriptions: Do not restore the secondary sidebar when LazyGit closes
Do not restore the secondary sidebar when LazyGit closes
Restore the secondary sidebar when LazyGit closes

lazygit-vscode.nativeFileOpening.description: Automatically handle file opening from lazygit using IPC instead of the 'code' CLI. When enabled, pressing 'e' opens files directly in VSCode without needing 'code' on PATH or 'editPreset: vscode' in your lazygit config.

lazygit-vscode.terminalKeybindingFallbac.description: Inject temporary LazyGit custom commands for Ctrl+E, Ctrl+F, Ctrl+D, and Ctrl+X so VSCode views can still be opened when the integrated terminal sends control-letter shortcuts into LazyGit instead of VSCode.

lazygit-vscode.autoMaximizeWindow.description: Deprecated. LazyGit now opens in a maximized terminal panel.
lazygit-vscode.autoMaximizeWindow.markdownDeprecationMessage: **Deprecated**: LazyGit now opens in a maximized terminal panel.

lazygit-vscode.venvActivationDelay.description: Delay in milliseconds to wait for Python virtual environment activation before launching lazygit

lazygit-vscode.autoHideSideBar.description: Auto-hide the side bar when showing lazygit

lazygit-vscode.autoHidePanel.description: Auto-hide the panel when showing lazygit
lazygit-vscode.autoHidePanel.markdownDeprecationMessage: **Deprecated**: LazyGit now runs in the terminal panel, so this setting is ignored.

scripts.pretest: npm run compile && npm run lint
